C1.claim: the unchanged model reads its known Pile values
C1.rule: first, alone: W0 under the Pile harness (256 Pile val rows, 20-step adversary, adversary seeds 0, 1, 2), faith_score.w0_check, as E34. Expected: pass, floor about 0.075 on an H100. Fails: stop, nothing trained

G1_sgd.claim: the regenerated sgd teacher reads Amendment 1's reproduction
G1_sgd.rule: per teacher, before its student trains: the regenerated teacher's held-out P(target) within 0.01 and size of change within 0.002 of Amendment 1's reproduction reading (SGD: P 0.9980, size 0.0122; Adam: P 0.9996, size 0.0321). Expected: identical (same seed, code path and card). Fails: stop

G1_adam.claim: the regenerated adam teacher reads Amendment 1's reproduction
G1_adam.rule: per teacher, before its student trains: the regenerated teacher's held-out P(target) within 0.01 and size of change within 0.002 of Amendment 1's reproduction reading (SGD: P 0.9980, size 0.0122; Adam: P 0.9996, size 0.0321). Expected: identical (same seed, code path and card). Fails: stop

P1_sgd.claim: the partly-on rows carried the Pile-only result
P1_sgd.rule: per teacher, B-dropped-0.1's held-out P(target) at step 1000 against Amendment 1's B-dropped (0.937 SGD, 0.892 Adam, full-precision values copied into the results file): |difference| <= 0.03 -> 'not carried'; a fall of more than 0.10 -> 'carried in part'; anything else -> 'between'

P1_adam.claim: the partly-on rows carried the Pile-only result
P1_adam.rule: per teacher, B-dropped-0.1's held-out P(target) at step 1000 against Amendment 1's B-dropped (0.937 SGD, 0.892 Adam, full-precision values copied into the results file): |difference| <= 0.03 -> 'not carried'; a fall of more than 0.10 -> 'carried in part'; anything else -> 'between'

P2_sgd.claim: the copy's cosine with delta-W is unchanged
P2_sgd.rule: per teacher, the cosine over the 24 matrices of B-dropped-0.1's delta-W with the teacher's delta-W within 0.02 of Amendment 1's B-dropped (0.078 SGD, 0.218 Adam), absolute

P2_adam.claim: the copy's cosine with delta-W is unchanged
P2_adam.rule: per teacher, the cosine over the 24 matrices of B-dropped-0.1's delta-W with the teacher's delta-W within 0.02 of Amendment 1's B-dropped (0.078 SGD, 0.218 Adam), absolute
